prompt: Explain Kafka like I am new to distributed systems, including how partitions, replication, and consumer groups fit together architecturally.
human_rubric: Builds a compact beginner mental model of Kafka.
Uses one concrete example to connect producers, the durable log, and consumers.
Explains how partitions, replication, and consumer groups fit together at a conceptual architecture level.
Avoids an implementation-detail dump or encyclopedic survey.
